content: Accept the things to which fate binds you, and love the people with whom fate brings you together, but do so with all your soul.
author: Marcus Aurelius
story:
Written in military campaign tents along the freezing Danube River during the Marcomannic Wars (170–180 CE), Marcus wrestled with the Antonine Plague, the betrayal of General Avidius Cassius, and the crushing responsibilities of the Roman Empire. In his private journal, he strictly commanded himself to master his judgments, embrace cosmic duty, and remain uncorrupted by imperial power.

Exploring the mysteries of human connection, Marcus Aurelius saw that genuine fulfillment cannot be hoarded or manufactured through egoic control. It blossoms only when we lower our defenses, dissolve self-importance, and meet the world with openhearted generosity.
reflectionPrompt: How can you extend greater compassion to yourself for your own imperfections right now?
